'''A2-B4''' was an [[A2 Accounting/Business Unit|accounting and business droid]] owned by [[Anstaal|Lord Anstaal]]. A2-B4 later came under the possession of [[Sybegh Abya]].

The droid had a hemispherical body, two fine [[Limb/Legends|manipulators]], a [[Vocabulator/Legends|speech synthesizer]], visual and auditory [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]], a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], and a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor unit]] that allowed it to hover up to two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in the air. It was one meter wide and .6 meters tall. It cost 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
